title: bomify plugin "sbom generate" output
description: What a bomify-plugin-<kind> binary's "sbom generate" must print to stdout on success, per plugins/contracts/sbom/v1/CONTRACT.md: the subset of a CycloneDX BOM bomify reads, its metadata, components, and dependencies. Each is CycloneDX's own object, referenced from CycloneDX's schema (1.7's definitions, which cover 1.5 and 1.6 too), with bomify's rules beside it. Three rules can't be expressed here: every bom-ref equals its component's purl, bom-refs are unique among components, and every dependencies ref and dependsOn names a bom-ref in the document.

timestamp.description: Not allowed: the same inputs produce the same document.

component.description: What the SBOM was generated from, e.g. the chart.

dependencies.description: What depends on what, by bom-ref; optional.

packaged.description: A CycloneDX component, identified by its purl, with nothing nested.

components.description: Nothing nested: bomify build only packages top-level components.
